summary: This bill expands an existing grant program to allow funding for public service announcement campaigns aimed at preventing substance use among youth and requires annual reports on these campaigns, including their effectiveness.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on youth substance use prevention through public service announcement campaigns. It aims to reduce drug use among young people, which aligns with a stricter drug enforcement stance by discouraging use.

The bill expands a grant program under the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act, which is a criminal justice statute. While its focus is on prevention rather than direct enforcement or punishment, it uses a criminal justice framework to address substance use, leaning towards a preventative aspect of stricter justice by aiming to reduce crime-related issues before they occur.
